  • Attempted Arson: June 25, 06:14 PM (EPA), 1177 Newell Road—42-year-old male refused to leave store, attempted to light garbage can on fire. Subject had prior probation record.
  • Assault / Group Altercation: June 25, 09:24 PM (EPA), Starbucks 1745 East Bay Shore Road—Group of 4-6 males engaged in fist fight; subjects fled on foot and by vehicle before arrival.
  • Suspicious Vehicle / Disturbance:
    • June 25, 12:21 AM (EPA), 253 West Stereo Drive / Camellia Drive: Red Jeep with unknown plate, occupied couple arguing—male in 20s in block sweater, female ~18 in gray sweater and pink pants sitting on curb.
    • June 25, 04:16 AM (MPPD), Best Western 15 El Camino: Disturbance with male voices yelling for "Rafe"; car door heard opening. RP has white Nissan Rogue parked outside.

    • June 25, 06:48 AM (MPPD): Hit-and-run at 781 Ivy with suspect identified.
    • June 25, 12:20 PM (APD): Text message extortion / scam—subject named David threatening to post inappropriate photos on Facebook if victim didn't pay (demanded $300, reduced to $150, then $50). No money transferred.

Summary: Primary safety concerns are indecent exposure / prowler activity, multiple domestic violence incidents with some involving protective order violations, and child endangerment. One attempted arson incident and group assault also noted. Most routine traffic enforcement occurring throughout 11 PM–5 AM odd hours.
